findings.recommendation: Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config and set 'PermitRootLogin no' to prevent direct administrative root access over the network.
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config and set 'PasswordAuthentication no' to enforce robust SSH key-based authentication.
Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config and change the listening port to '22' (or a non-standard custom port) to mitigate automated scanning bots.
